notes.owns: The five tables 01-TARGET.md §2.1 assigns to ads, plus the implied platform tables ads_processed_events and ads_idempotency. They live in the service's OWN D1 (levonis-ads-db), not in the shared core database.
notes.reads: Empty on purpose. Ads joins nothing: PurchaseCompleted carries user_hash and Ads looks the consent snapshot up in its own ads_consent_snapshots (01-TARGET.md §9.1). tests/serviceBoundaries.test.ts fails on the first foreign table a SQL literal names.
notes.calls: Empty: Ads calls no other service. It is a pure consumer plus outbound provider HTTP through fetchWithBudget.
notes.publishes: AdConversionSent / AdConversionFailed (03-EVENTS.md §4) have no v1 schema yet, so nothing is declared — tests/eventSchemas.test.ts refuses a publishes entry without a schema, and declaring one would also force an AUDIT/ANALYTICS binding onto a Worker that must hold none.
notes.consumes: Exactly the six types subscriptions.ts lists for ads. UserCreated is deliberately absent: no consent can exist at signup (03-EVENTS.md §3.1). Every one of the six is pseudonymous or none — CONSUMER_PII_MAX pins ads to pseudonymous and the kit refuses a personal envelope before any state is touched.
notes.secrets: Names only, never values. A provider whose secret NAMES are not all present is NOT configured, and every delivery for it is recorded status='sandbox' with no outbound request — that is also the emergency kill switch (01-TARGET.md §9.1).
